title: §5Gather Their "Support"
description: §5§oNow listen kid, I need some contigency. If things with the Black King & Queen go haywire, I need numbers on my side so I can rise up and take the throne. Some pledges of loyalty, in the form of signatures, would be great.

§5§oIf you can head to the &#FF03FEBarracks§5, theres some knives and paper. &#FF03FEHolding a flint knife, with some paper in your other hand§5, should be enough to intimidate a &#FF03FEpawn§5 into giving you a signature.
